name: Night life with bright moon pastel colors
svg:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 530" width="1200" height="530">
    <rect width="1200" height="530" fill="#FFFFFF" />
    
                    <g transform="translate(0, 0)">
                        <rect width="240" height="460" fill="#1E1B32" />
                        <text x="120" y="416" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="monospace" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">#1E1B32</text>
                        <text x="120" y="440" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Midnight Indigo</text>
                    </g>
                
                    <g transform="translate(240, 0)">
                        <rect width="240" height="460" fill="#B19CD9" />
                        <text x="120" y="416" fill="#0F172A" font-family="monospace" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">#B19CD9</text>
                        <text x="120" y="440" fill="#0F172A" fill-opacity="0.85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Pastel Purple</text>
                    </g>
                
                    <g transform="translate(480, 0)">
                        <rect width="240" height="460" fill="#FFB3BA" />
                        <text x="120" y="416" fill="#0F172A" font-family="monospace" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">#FFB3BA</text>
                        <text x="120" y="440" fill="#0F172A" fill-opacity="0.85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Neon Blush</text>
                    </g>
                
                    <g transform="translate(720, 0)">
                        <rect width="240" height="460" fill="#BAE1FF" />
                        <text x="120" y="416" fill="#0F172A" font-family="monospace" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">#BAE1FF</text>
                        <text x="120" y="440" fill="#0F172A" fill-opacity="0.85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Lunar Sky</text>
                    </g>
                
                    <g transform="translate(960, 0)">
                        <rect width="240" height="460" fill="#FDFD96" />
                        <text x="120" y="416" fill="#0F172A" font-family="monospace" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">#FDFD96</text>
                        <text x="120" y="440" fill="#0F172A" fill-opacity="0.85" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle">Bright Moon</text>
                    </g>
                
    <rect y="460" width="1200" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF" />
    <text x="24" y="492" fill="#0F172A" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold">night life with bright moon, pastel colors</text>
    <text x="24" y="514" fill="#64748B" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="13">ChromaAI Palette • #1E1B32  #B19CD9  #FFB3BA  #BAE1FF  #FDFD96</text>
</svg>
